page.content:
Michael, Judith, and the bloodline later films argue over.

How Myers family connects

  • Character: Michael Myers — Michael is the Myers child who becomes the Shape.
  • Character: Judith Myers — Judith is Michael's sister and first victim.
  • Location: Myers house — The Myers family lived in the house Michael comes back to.

What is Myers family?

The Myers family is the Haddonfield household shattered when six-year-old Michael kills Judith — the origin later sequels expand or erase.

Key threads lead to Michael Myers, Judith Myers and Myers house.
